questions.question: When fuels containing carbon are burned in oxygen, which gas is commonly released into the atmosphere?

options: Two carbon atoms and one oxygen atom
One carbon atom and one oxygen atom
One carbon atom and two oxygen atoms
Two carbon atoms and two oxygen atoms

questions.question: Approximately what percentage of Earth's atmosphere is made up of carbon dioxide?
Which of the following gases is classified as a greenhouse gas?

options: An increase in average global temperature, known as global warming
A decrease in the global sea levels due to freezing
An increase in the concentration of nitrogen gas
A sudden decrease in the rate of photosynthesis

Extreme heat melts the grains into a uniform liquid

questions.question: In which type of rock are fossils exclusively found?

They keep Earth's temperature warm enough for human life

They prevent the formation of clouds and rain

It forms a white precipitate that turns limewater milky
It turns damp blue litmus paper red
